docs.title: Context
docs.text: Our monolithic system was becoming increasingly difficult to scale and maintain. Services were tightly coupled, and performance degraded under load.

docs.title: Decision
docs.text: We decided to adopt an event-driven architecture to decouple services and enable asynchronous communication.

docs.title: Consequences
docs.text:
• ✅ Improved scalability and resilience.
  • ✅ Services can evolve independently.
  • ⚠️ Introduced the need for a central event backbone and governance for event contracts.

docs.title: Context
docs.text: Following ADR 0001, we needed a reliable event backbone. We evaluated several options including Kafka and Azure Event Hubs.

docs.title: Decision
docs.text: We selected Azure Event Hubs as our event backbone due to its managed nature and seamless integration with our Azure infrastructure.

docs.title: Consequences
docs.text:
• ✅ Reduced operational overhead.
  • ✅ Easy integration with existing Azure services.
  • ⚠️ Introduced the need for schema governance to manage event contracts.

docs.title: Context
docs.text: With Azure Event Hubs in place, we needed a way to manage and validate event schemas to prevent contract drift between producers and consumers.

docs.title: Decision
docs.text: We adopted the Azure Event Hubs Schema Registry to store and validate event schemas.

docs.title: Consequences
docs.text:
• ✅ Enforced schema compatibility across services.
  • ✅ Provided a single source of truth for event contracts.
  • ⚠️ Required integration with CI/CD pipelines for automated validation.

docs.title: ADR 0004: Enforce Schema Validation in CI/CD
Context
docs.text: Manual schema validation was error-prone and inconsistent. We needed automation to ensure schema compatibility before deployment.

docs.title: Decision
docs.text: We integrated schema validation checks into our CI/CD pipelines to catch issues early in the development lifecycle.

docs.title: Consequences
docs.text:
• ✅ Prevented incompatible schemas from being deployed.
  • ✅ Increased confidence in event-driven integrations.
  • ⚠️ Required teams to follow schema registration and validation guidelines.
